slots.name: wedding payment status
slots.sentence: And last month, Trump defended his son Donald Trump Jr., who permitted a Russian oligarch, Umar Kremlev, to pay hundreds of thousands of dollars related to his wedding, including for help renting a private island and putting on a fireworks display.
